title: Estée Lauder appoints ex-L'Oréal Gaétane Baudry to lead Bobbi Brown
summary: The Estée Lauder Companies has appointed Gaétane Baudry as Senior Vice President / Global General Manager, Bobbi Brown, effective October 8, 2026. Based in New York, she will report to Lisa Sequino, Global President, Makeup Brands.
